summary:
We made an app named SPACECARE to detect the problems faced by the astronauts, who are in the space mission and we created a website named ASTROCARE to check the astronauts health in ground control center monitoring system.
It is important because it provide real-time data from space, we planned to give more accurate AI assistant to give sudden response to any problems faced by the astronauts.  
Use APK link provided in google drive to check the complete working in android phone, this is to handle the user authentication, It's Completely safe APK.
details:
Mainly astronauts use our app to give real-time data to ground control center, where the whole data from the app is processed and shown in the website in ground control center, from that we can easily monitor the astronauts, we can add the AI assistant to our app which give the solution to the stimuli happened for astronauts in space.

Our project is creative, because it is creating a bridge between ground control center and astronauts by using artificial intelligence.

We consider immune changes, bone loss, cardiovascular events, and behavioral health problems as factors for this project.
